text:
emily: quick follow-up from arch sync: propose a lightweight shape token we call X-Shape-Score (0..3) emitted by the router. scheduler maps score->window_ms probabilistically to smooth transitions. keeps router cheap and lets scheduler handle policy.

rao: sounds promising. how cheap is score computation? we need it O(1) and branchless on hot path.

emily: plan is two simple metrics: recent_token_variance and verbatim_pct (exact-repeat fraction). combine with a tiny table lookup to compute 0..3. no regexp, just counters.

taylor: main worry is fairness. if high-score requests get large windows, low-latency ones on same GPU could suffer. we should add a soft per-score admission budget and a preempt hint to favor low-score when headroom low.

emily: agreed. soft budgets implemented as credit pools per score with periodic refill. credits consumed proportional to token_budget of the batch. no hard evict, only admission steering.

jin: telemetry wishlist: shape_score_histogram, score_to_window_chosen, per-score p99, and per-tenant credit_balance. please add mislabel_rate (score vs heuristic in front-end) too.

rao: experiment idea: three-arm A/B: (A) baseline fixed 8ms window, (B) score->window mapping conservative, (C) score mapping + credits. measure p50/p90/p99, batch_fill, token_cost, and cross-tenant fairness. 72h and synthetic spikes.

taylor: also add safety hooks: sample 1/1000 outputs for semantic drift when window changes. automatic rollback if semantic divergence > threshold. tie to rollout console.

emily: config sketch:
```
router:
  emit: X-Shape-Score
  heuristic_params: { variance_k: 6, repeat_thresh: 0.6 }
  auth_override: false

scheduler:
  score_map: { 0: {w:4,mx:128}, 1: {w:8,mx:512}, 2: {w:16,mx:1024}, 3: {w:32,mx:2048} }
  credit_pools:
    refill_per_sec: 20000
    per_score_weight: [1,2,4,8]
```

jin: small nit: prefer powers-of-two ms for histogram buckets. makes dashboards simpler.

rao: last thought: make the mapping probabilistic for border scores to avoid oscillation. scheduler picks window with a softmax over expected fill and tail risk.

emily: action items: emily+rao to prototype router counters, taylor to spec telemetry/rollback, jin to build bench harness for three-arm A/B. will open RFC with sim results. bench-bot: queued job run id=br-2026-03-21-09.

both: :thumbsup:
